name: PR416 no-ReleaseBallControl focused

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - evidence/pr416-no-release-control-focused
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/pr416-no-release-control-focused.yml

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  focused-regression:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        test_name:
          - AControlledCarrierIsActuallyDispossessed
          - BothOutcomesOccur_TheBallIsSometimesWonAndSometimesKnockedLoose
          - TacklesHappenInComposedPlay
          - ATackleFoulIsGivenAsASlideTackleAndNotJudgedTwice
          - sim_match_engine_shot_outcomes
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.0.x'
      - name: Ablate only elevated ReleaseBallControl promotion
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          p = Path('src/ball-physics/BallCollision.cs')
          s = p.read_text()
          old = '''            // ERR-001-006: Stationary is a ground-rest state. An elevated controlled ball
            // released without a kick must fall under gravity rather than freeze in mid-air.
            ball.State = ball.Position.z > BallPhysicsConstants.State.AirborneEnterThreshold
                ? BallStateType.Airborne
                : BallStateType.Stationary;
          '''
          new = '''            // Evidence arm: ablate only ERR-001-006 elevated non-kick release promotion.
            ball.State = BallStateType.Stationary;
          '''
          if old not in s:
              raise SystemExit('ReleaseBallControl target block not found exactly once')
          if s.count(old) != 1:
              raise SystemExit(f'ReleaseBallControl target block count={s.count(old)}')
          p.write_text(s.replace(old, new, 1))
          PY
          git diff --check
          git diff -- src/ball-physics/BallCollision.cs
      - name: Generate projects and restore
        run: |
          python3 tools/dotnet-ci/generate_projects.py
          dotnet restore tools/dotnet-ci/TacticalDirector.gen.sln
      - name: Run focused MatchEngine target
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set +e
          out="artifacts/pr416-no-release-${{ matrix.test_name }}"
          mkdir -p "$out"
          dotnet test src/match-engine/tests/match-engine-tests.gen.csproj \
            --no-restore \
            --filter "Name=${{ matrix.test_name }}" \
            --logger "console;verbosity=detailed" \
            --logger "trx;LogFileName=${{ matrix.test_name }}.trx" \
            --results-directory "$out" \
            2>&1 | tee "$out/console.log"
          dotnet_status=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
          python3 - "$out/${{ matrix.test_name }}.trx" "${{ matrix.test_name }}" <<'PY'
          import sys, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
          path, name = sys.argv[1:]
          root = ET.parse(path).getroot()
          rows = [e for e in root.iter() if e.tag.endswith('UnitTestResult') and e.attrib.get('testName', '').endswith(name)]
          if len(rows) != 1:
              print(f'TARGET_RESULT {name} AMBIGUOUS count={len(rows)}')
              sys.exit(2)
          outcome = rows[0].attrib.get('outcome', '<missing>')
          print(f'TARGET_RESULT {name} {outcome}')
          if outcome != 'Passed':
              sys.exit(1)
          PY
          trx_status=$?
          if [ "$dotnet_status" -ne 0 ] || [ "$trx_status" -ne 0 ]; then
            exit 1
          fi
      - name: Upload focused evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pr416-no-release-${{ matrix.test_name }}-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: artifacts/pr416-no-release-${{ matrix.test_name }}/
          if-no-files-found: error
